---
title: "Certification from Other Statistical Societies"
---

Members of the ASA who are certified by other member organizations of the Alliance for Data Science Professionals and are in good standing with their member organization will **automatically become DSP or AdvDSP certified members of the ASA** upon written request with:

1. Proof of certified status
2. Agreement to maintain their certification in the other society
3. Agreement to abide by the ASA's Ethical Guidelines for Statistical Practice
4. Payment of ASA dues and certification fees
